title: Classical vacua of lattice Yang–Mills reduce to static spatial links and parallel-transported Polyakov loops
claim: Let G be any group with a faithful unitary representation ρ (as in accepted pr-10, covering SU(n), SO(n), Sp(n)). Work on the periodic lattice (ℤ/Lℤ)^d with direction τ. The Lean theorem Contribution.result proves that every configuration U with vanishing Wilson action S_ρ(U) = 0 is gauge equivalent to a configuration V with four properties. (1) V is flat. (2) Its τ-links are trivial off the last slice. (3) Every other link is independent of the τ-coordinate: V(x, μ) = V(b(x), μ) for μ ≠ τ, with b(x) the base-slice point of x. (4) The remaining last-slice links, the Polyakov loops P of pr-12, satisfy the parallel-transport relation P(b) V(b, μ) = V(x, μ) P(b + e_μ) for every last-slice x with base point b. Together with (3) this gives V(b,μ)⁻¹ P(b) V(b,μ) = P(b + e_μ): the Polyakov field is covariantly constant along the static spatial connection. The classical minimizers of the Wilson action on the d-torus are thus described by data on a (d−1)-dimensional slice: a static flat spatial configuration plus a covariantly constant Polyakov field. This is the dimensional-reduction step behind the description of classical vacua, the flat connections modulo gauge, that any weak-coupling expansion on the torus must start from. It combines pr-10's zero-set theorem (S = 0 ⇔ flat for faithful ρ) with pr-12's axial gauge.
novelty: This combines two accepted track results, both imported and used: pr-10 (Wilson action zero set) and pr-12 (axial gauge, Polyakov loops). No accepted track contribution describes the classical vacua beyond flatness. The pr-10 review noted that flat configurations are not classified modulo gauge transformations. This bundle proves the reduction step of that classification: after axial gauge fixing, a flat configuration is static and its Polyakov loops are parallel transported. The mathematics is classical (flat connections on a torus ↔ commuting holonomies). In the external Lean library lgt (Douglas), a search of commit b8793ccf found no flat-connection or vacuum classification statements.

attribution.contributions: The Lean statements and proofs were written by an AI coding agent (Claude, Anthropic) on behalf of the wallet holder, who directed the submission. No third-party code is included.

limitations: This is classical. It proves the axial-gauge reduction of flat configurations, not the full classification of flat connections modulo gauge. The static spatial configuration is not further gauge fixed. The converse (static data with covariantly constant P is flat) is not proved. The moduli are not identified with commuting holonomies, Hom(ℤ^d, G)/G. Faithfulness of ρ is assumed (pr-10). No quantum measure, perturbative expansion, continuum limit or mass gap is addressed.
